scope: A bounded selection experiment in the existing physical fallback, plus common completion fixes; not a replacement general ranking framework.

new_candidate.question: What happens to the same original piece captured at one root, and what is the observed price in each provided line?
new_candidate.subject: Exactly one distinct original victim of an actual root capture in the two certified arms.
new_candidate.contrast: Different observed removal/survival or different actual price. Same result and price with different timing is insufficient.
new_candidate.price: Existing accounts and exact actual events; narrow dependent recovery requires an immediate or continuously verified reply. Subject's own price is retained.
guards: Both arms have closed certified prices without unresolved duty costs
Already selected condition/use action and proof remain owned
Existing capturing-use account price remains covered
No fabricated attack, force, evaluation cause, or root causality
new_candidate.detail: Unselected typed statements and complete line ledgers remain available; position proof anchors need not be spoken as events.

common_completion: Separate action references from position-only proof references while retaining exact proof and board links.
Actual roots, necessary trade closure and actual check replies are still expressed or semantically represented.
Actual supported countercapture can own an adjacent ally loss only with exact support, original identity and legal recapture evidence; unplayed recapture remains proof only.
not_implemented: General ranking of competing closed questions
known_boundaries: Quiet-use later price is not certified by the capturing-use guard
Existing adjacency/sign compensation heuristics are not replaced
Closed actual use is not importance
fresh_evaluation: One attempt per frozen request, no source tuning or request reselection after fresh output. Facts and reader obligations are written before basic prose is read.
